text.Taşıt Kredisi Alırken Bilmeniz Gerekenle: What to Know Before Getting a Vehicle Loan - KredimGeldi
text.Taşıt kredisinde kredi tutarı ve vade sı: Loan amount and term limits for vehicle loans, liens, kasko, and the differences between new and used cars. A guide to planning your loan right when buying a vehicle.
text.Araç fiyatına göre değişen tutar ve vade: Amount and term limits that vary with the vehicle price, liens, kasko and what to watch for with used vehicles. Plan your vehicle loan the right way.
text.Taşıt kredisi, sıfır veya ikinci el bir: A vehicle loan is a consumer loan used to finance part of the price when buying a new or used car, with the vehicle pledged as collateral. Since vehicle prices are high, choosing the right amount and term makes a big difference to your budget.
text.Taşıt kredisi nasıl işler?: How does a vehicle loan work?
text.Taşıt kredilerinde kullanılabilecek tuta: Under BDDK (Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency) regulations, the amount and term available on vehicle loans are capped based on the vehicle's invoice or kasko value. For more expensive vehicles, the share that can be financed drops and the term gets shorter. The term limits currently applied by the calculator on our site are as follows:
text.Kalan tutarı peşinat olarak karşılamanız: You need to cover the remaining amount as a down payment. So when setting your vehicle budget, pin down your down payment first.
text.Bankanın önerdiği kasko yerine farklı si: Instead of the kasko offered by the bank, you can also get quotes from other insurance companies. It's enough for the bank to be listed on the policy as the pledgee (lien holder).
text.Sıfır ve ikinci el araçta farklar: Differences between new and used vehicles
text.İkinci el araçlarda kredi tutarı genelli: For used vehicles, the loan amount is usually based on the kasko value. As the vehicle gets older, the term the bank offers may get shorter. Before you buy:
text.Aracın hasar ve tramer kaydını sorgulayı: Check the vehicle's damage and insurance claim (Tramer) record.
text.Üzerinde başka bir rehin, haciz veya tra: Make sure there are no other liens, seizures or traffic fines on it.
text.Güvendiğiniz bir serviste ekspertiz yapt: Have a vehicle inspection done at a service center you trust.
text.Taksidi nasıl planlamalı?: How should you plan the installment?
text.Araç sahibi olmanın maliyeti kredi taksi: The cost of owning a vehicle isn't just the loan installment. Add fuel, maintenance, tires, parking, MTV (motor vehicle tax) and insurance costs to your monthly budget. The installment needs to stay comfortably affordable with all of these expenses included.
text.Taşıt kredisi bir tüketici kredisidir. V: A vehicle loan is a consumer loan. You can repay it partially or fully before it is due; the bank is required to discount the interest on the amount repaid early.
text.Araç bedelini ve vadeyi seçin, bankaları: Choose the vehicle price and term, and compare the banks' vehicle loan offers.
text.Kredili araç satılabilir mi?: Can a financed vehicle be sold?
text.Araç üzerinde bankanın rehni bulunduğu i: Because the bank holds a lien on the vehicle, the loan must be paid off or the bank's approval obtained before the sale.
text.Taşıt kredisinde kasko zorunlu mu?: Is kasko mandatory for a vehicle loan?
text.Yasal bir zorunluluk değildir, ancak ban: It isn't a legal requirement, but banks usually require comprehensive car insurance (kasko) for the duration of the loan to protect their collateral.
text.İkinci el araç için taşıt kredisi alınab: Can I get a vehicle loan for a used car?
text.Evet. Kredi tutarı genellikle aracın kas: Yes. The loan amount is usually based on the vehicle's kasko value, and the term may be shorter depending on the vehicle's age.

html.Banka, satın alacağınız aracın bedelinin: The bank lends a certain portion of the price of the vehicle you're buying and places a lien on the vehicle. The vehicle remains under lien until the loan is fully repaid; to sell the vehicle during this time, the loan must first be paid off or the bank must give its approval.
html.<strong>Faiz ve vergiler:</strong> Taşıt: Interest and taxes: On vehicle loans, 15% KKDF (Resource Utilization Support Fund) and 15% BSMV (Banking and Insurance Transaction Tax) are added to the interest.
html.<strong>Dosya masrafı:</strong> Kredi tu: Processing fee: Up to 0.5% of the loan amount.
html.<strong>Rehin işlemleri:</strong> Rehnin: Lien procedures: There may be fees for recording the lien with a notary or in the registration records.
html.<strong>Kasko:</strong> Bankalar, temina: Kasko: Banks usually require comprehensive car insurance (kasko) for the duration of the loan to protect the vehicle that serves as collateral.
